# Image compressor

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/image-compressor/

Reduce photo file size by adjusting JPEG or WebP quality and limiting image width. Compare the exported size with the original before downloading.

## How to use it

1. Choose a clear, supported image from your device.
2. Adjust the image settings and run the tool.
3. Inspect the preview, then download or copy the result.

## Example

Export a 4000-pixel photo at 1920 pixels wide and 75% quality for a lighter web page.

## Limits and checks

An already optimized image can produce a larger output. Lowering quality trades fine detail for a smaller file.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
